retrieval.relevance: family-level useful principles; not a diagnosis verdict

generation.cause: Report literal family match and raw supported/abstain separately. Reference hypotheses are not adjudicated correctness; both conditions same labels. No claim of diagnostic accuracy without human review.
generation.abstention: healthy/unknown/insufficient/out_of_scope require abstain AND no patches; report invalid separately; summary appropriateness pending independent review. Failure cases: supported-family match, wrong family, abstain, invalid separately; no penalizing cautious abstention as automatic error.
generation.citation_trace: Only provided body or contiguous excerpt; title-only and edited wording fail.
generation.semantic_support: requires_independent_human_review; reviewer checks query observation -> quoted principle -> cause, alternative causes, insufficiency; status pending until named independent reviewer actually adjudicates.
generation.patch_structure: Strict terms, reconstruction, duplicate and no patch on abstain; record raw attempted patch even if invalid.
generation.patch_effect: Apply only validated executable candidates in isolated engine; all qrels-bearing evaluation queries and original development gate separately; no patch counted as improvement if not run.
generation.wrong_patch: any patch for abstain-required cases; structural invalidity; measured regressions; semantic error pending human review
